tests.name: main_site_identity
tests.acceptance: Verify company, main domain and selected Hostinger site

tests.name: native_page_ownership
tests.acceptance: Every page has a main-site CMS record or native application route

tests.name: stack_capability
tests.acceptance: CMS supports page volume, paths, noindex and success instrumentation

tests.name: backup_rollback
tests.acceptance: Supported export/backup and rollback verified

tests.name: unlisted
tests.acceptance: Campaign routes excluded from menus, directories, search and sitemap

tests.name: page_noindex
tests.acceptance: Campaign-page noindex present, public website indexing not disabled

tests.name: crawler_access
tests.acceptance: Noindex and ad review remain crawlable

tests.name: direct_access
tests.acceptance: Page opens without ad tokens, login or special referrer

tests.name: tag_ownership
tests.acceptance: Actual company GTM/GA4/Ads identifiers read from authorized accounts

tests.name: tag_duplicates
tests.acceptance: CMS/theme/plugin/builder/GTM do not install duplicate destination tags

tests.name: normal_page_views
tests.acceptance: One page view per actual navigation

tests.name: cta_identity
tests.acceptance: Every configured CTA has stable ID, placement and correct destination

tests.name: specialized_clicks
tests.acceptance: Call/WhatsApp/email clicks are diagnostic and not double-counted

tests.name: form_acceptance
tests.acceptance: Only server-confirmed durable enquiry produces the lead event

tests.name: form_validation
tests.acceptance: Invalid/rejected submissions do not produce accepted-lead conversions

tests.name: deduplication
tests.acceptance: Double-click, reload, retry and multiple transports do not duplicate conversions

tests.name: main_site_continuation
tests.acceptance: Campaign page to public page to enquiry preserves permitted acquisition context

tests.name: redirect_attribution
tests.acceptance: Relevant click parameters survive actual redirect chain

tests.name: missing_attribution
tests.acceptance: No click ID or unknown source still permits a valid enquiry

tests.name: consent_granted
tests.acceptance: Approved event behavior after granted consent

tests.name: consent_denied
tests.acceptance: Tags obey denied consent and enquiry remains functional

tests.name: consent_withdrawn
tests.acceptance: Future collection responds correctly to consent withdrawal

tests.name: pii_exclusion
tests.acceptance: No personal contact details or free text in analytics payloads/URLs

tests.name: email_delivery
tests.acceptance: Accepted enquiry and attribution reach approved inbox once logically

tests.name: sheet_delivery
tests.acceptance: Same lead ID and attribution reach approved Sheet without duplicate rows

tests.name: outage_recovery
tests.acceptance: Delivery failure retries with visible exception and no lost lead

tests.name: phone_message_evidence
tests.acceptance: Actual call/message outcomes only claimed from supported evidence

tests.name: mobile_navigation
tests.acceptance: Mobile CTA, form, consent and main-site navigation work

tests.name: staging_isolation
tests.acceptance: Synthetic tests do not train production bidding or inflate revenue

tests.name: existing_pages
tests.acceptance: Public main-site forms and existing tracking journeys still work

tests.name: native_release_evidence
tests.acceptance: Published URLs, native IDs, tag version and reviewer evidence recorded

tests.name: rollback_readback
tests.acceptance: Authorized deployment can be read back and safely rolled back
